Text.Text: Our bargain is settled. You learned when to stop feeding; he never did. You've finished my Hunger of the Dark trials. I have no further work for you here.
Reach rank 50 in Force before you ask for these lessons. Hunger without control is a short education.

A coven in the crypt depths is feeding on power it cannot control. Their trial tablet will tell me what they've been teaching. Defeat six Hunger of the Dark Adepts in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Crypt Trial Tablet; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina. I'll give you the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Hunger of the Dark.

Here's the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths Key. Use 'Sith Crypt Depths' in Korriban, Sith Crypt. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Hunger of the Dark Adepts, then return with the Hunger of the Dark Crypt Trial Tablet.

Anyone can devour. A rancor can devour. The discipline is in the digestion: taking a life's heat into yourself without letting its screaming become yours. The coven below never learned that. They gulp and gulp and wonder why they are always empty. I will teach you portion control, piece by piece, at my price. The tablet is the first installment.

Use 'Sith Crypt Depths' in Korriban, Sith Crypt. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Hunger of the Dark Adepts in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Crypt Trial Tablet; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina.

Oh, they bite. Six of them, each one swollen on stolen vitae and starving anyway. They will try to drink you where you stand, and the delicious irony is that you are here to learn the very trick they will attempt. Watch how they do it wrong. That is the cheapest lesson on the menu, and it comes free.
Defeat six Hunger of the Dark Adepts in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Crypt Trial Tablet; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina.
You've defeated six Hunger of the Dark Adepts. Let me see the Hunger of the Dark Crypt Trial Tablet.
The tablet gives us a clear account of their teaching. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are feeding their rituals through a stolen focus shard. Bring it to me. Defeat five Hunger of the Dark Specialists in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Ritual Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Defeat five Hunger of the Dark Specialists to secure the Hunger of the Dark Ritual Focus Shard, then return to me.

Badly? No. Precisely. That shard is a full pantry gathered by fools, years of swallowed life sitting in one stone because not one of them could digest it. In my hands it becomes curriculum. In yours, briefly, it becomes a lesson in carrying a feast you must not taste. Do not taste it. That is not one of my rules. It is a rule of anatomy.

Use 'Sith Crypt Depths' in Korriban, Sith Crypt. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat five Hunger of the Dark Specialists in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Ritual Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina.

Cooperate. The adepts fed alone; the specialists feed each other, passing your strength around their circle while you wonder why your knees have developed opinions. Break the circle and they are five hungry mouths. Leave it standing and you are the centerpiece. You see why I find teaching so easy? The syllabus keeps trying to eat the students.
Defeat five Hunger of the Dark Specialists in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Ritual Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina.
You've defeated five Hunger of the Dark Specialists. Let me see the Hunger of the Dark Ritual Focus Shard.
The focus is out of their hands. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

Their warden guards the deeper rites. Take his tomb sigil and end his watch. Defeat the Hunger of the Dark Warden in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Splintered Tomb Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Hunger of the Dark Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Hunger of the Dark Splintered Tomb Sigil.

Once, a rival of mine, if you can imagine anyone rivaling me. He went down to raid the coven's pantry and stayed to guard it, which tells you exactly what the deep tombs offer. Now he is appetite wearing armor, planted in the breach, fed by everything that tries to pass. He no longer wants to move. Wanting takes a self, and he traded his away for a fuller stomach.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Hunger of the Dark Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

The seal of the deep tomb doors, splintered the night the coven forced them open to reach what was buried. Each splinter still remembers being whole, and things that remember wholeness are worth a fortune to a man in my line of study. Bring it up and I pay in the richest teaching yet. He will not part with it politely. Nothing he has swallowed has ever come back up.

Defeat the Hunger of the Dark Warden in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Splintered Tomb Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Hunger of the Dark Warden. Let me see the Hunger of the Dark Splintered Tomb Sigil.
The sigil no longer backs the warden's claim. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four keepers give this coven its authority. Their rite token belongs in better hands. Defeat four members of the Hunger of the Dark Inner Circle in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Keeper's Rite Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Defeat four members of the Hunger of the Dark Inner Circle to secure the Hunger of the Dark Keeper's Rite Token, then return to me.

Restraint, of all things. The adepts gorge and the specialists pool, but the keepers ration. They keep the coven hungry on purpose, because hungry followers are obedient followers. It is nearly elegant, and it is entirely wasted on them. They hoard what they cannot digest and call the hoarding wisdom. A vault is not a stomach. Even they will learn that, briefly, when you arrive.

It is the coven's deed of table. Whoever bears it decides the portions: who feeds first, who feeds last, who is the feed. Take it and their whole hierarchy dies of hunger pangs. To me it is worth rather more, but that is between me and my studies, and my studies pay your tuition. Everyone eats. Is commerce not beautiful?

Keep your company if you enjoyed the warden's banquet; four keepers will happily restage it. They fight the way misers spend, grudging, careful, all together or not at all. Kill the generous one first. There is always one who spends strength too freely, and the other three lean on the habit. When the spendthrift falls, watch the rationing collapse.

Defeat four members of the Hunger of the Dark Inner Circle in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Hunger of the Dark Keeper's Rite Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina.
You've defeated four members of the Hunger of the Dark Inner Circle. Let me see the Hunger of the Dark Keeper's Rite Token.
Their authority to teach is ended. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master has consumed more than the coven can contain. Defeat him to settle our bargain. Defeat the Hunger of the Dark Master in Korriban, Final Ritual Chamber. Report back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Final Ritual Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Hunger of the Dark Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

A cautionary text with a pulse. He mastered feeding without being eaten, truly mastered it, and then met the one predator no discipline stops: his own success. Every meal made the next one necessary. Now he is a hole shaped like a man, wielding our art perfectly and tasting none of it. Study him while you kill him. He is the final page of the book you are buying.

Honesty at last. I like it. His death vacates the deepest larder on Korriban and retires the only practitioner whose hunger outranks mine. And, I confess, I want to know it can be done. That the art has an ending other than becoming him. You are my experiment in eating well. Do give me a good result. I have wagered rather a lot of teaching on you.

Feed him confusion. Three vessels, always moving, never the same one in reach twice. His draw is bottomless but it is not quick, and greed makes him linger on whoever tastes strongest. Let your hardiest friend be the flavor, and open him up while he savors. And when the hunger in you leans toward him at the end, and it will lean, remember that you have somewhere to put your appetite. He is what forgetting that looks like.

Defeat the Hunger of the Dark Master in Korriban, Final Ritual Chamber. Report back to me here in Korriban, Starport, Cantina; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Hunger of the Dark Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
Our bargain is settled. You learned when to stop feeding; he never did. You've earned the right to train Hunger of the Dark. Your final payment is ready.
Back to your bargain.
I'll defeat six Hunger of the Dark Adepts.
What do you mean, eat properly?
How do I reach this coven?
What are these adepts capable of?
Your price needs thinking about.
Here's the Hunger of the Dark Crypt Trial Tablet.
About the shard again.
I'll defeat five Hunger of the Dark Specialists.
Why do you want the shard so badly?
Where do they keep it?
What can five do that six adepts couldn't?
Not hungry yet.
Here's the Hunger of the Dark Ritual Focus Shard.
Back to the warden's table.
I'll defeat the Hunger of the Dark Warden.
What exactly is this warden?
Would you recommend bringing help?
And the sigil? What's it worth to you?
I need to find two more chairs first.
Here's the Hunger of the Dark Splintered Tomb Sigil.
Back to the keepers.
I'll defeat four members of the Hunger of the Dark Inner Circle.
What makes the keepers different from the rest?
Why does the token matter?
Any advice for four at once?
Let them starve a little longer first.
Here's the Hunger of the Dark Keeper's Rite Token.
Back to the last course.
I'll face the Hunger of the Dark Master and report back.
What did he become, exactly?
What do you get out of his death?
How do we survive his table?
Not until my companions are ready for it.
The Hunger of the Dark Master is defeated. Here's my report.
